method: validate() in Node on dist/wasm/nodejs, on a text that is one consonant followed by 2,500 and by 5,000 dependent vowel signs (one cluster, one double_matra issue per extra sign). Each size is timed over 7 rounds of 20 calls, and the fastest round is divided by 20 (ms_per_call_*); ratio is the large size over the small one, rounded to two decimals. A linear validator gives 2, a quadratic one 4; the check fails at 3 or more. Measured after one warm-up round.
